Question 5
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with velocity v(t)=6t+6t2, where t>0 is the time. If the particle is at the position x=2 when t=0, calculate the position x of the particle at time t.

a
x(t)=3t2+2t3−1
b
x(t)=3t2+2t3+1
c
x(t)=3t2+2t3
d
x(t)=3t2+2t3+2
e
x(t)=3t2+2t3−2
Submit
